universal_lens: Pitch-level run expectancy (RE24) aggregation by count enables dynamic game state quantification through probabilistic impact modeling. Robotic umpire transition induces strike zone normalization, altering player value metrics via stochastic run expectation shifts.

primitives.name: RoboticUmpireImpact
primitives.verbatim_quote: The purpose of our paper is to measure the impact that the robotic umpires will have on the outcomes of games and individual at bats.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes constant league-wide strike zone standards, identical pitcher quality across sample, and linear relationship between strike calls and run expectancy.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down at extreme pitch velocity or movement where human vs. robotic strike zones diverge significantly.

layer2.telemetry: Observed pitch-by-pitch discrepancy rate between robotic and human strike zone calls.
